title: Memory recall (recall-before-build; vault off)
summary: Look before you build: search memory and settled records first, and keep the memory folder valid and reachable.
why: Memory only helps when it is searched before work starts and when every leaf can be found; the heavier vault tooling stays off until memory is large enough to need it.

items.title: Recall before building; a CLOSED hit stops the work
items.does: Adds a rule: before any non-trivial item, search memory, the ledger and the settled list for the task in your own words; a settled or closed hit stops the work.
items.why: Settled items were re-opened and re-built across sessions because nobody looked first; a search costs seconds, a rebuild costs a session.

items.title: Split memory index into domain sub-indexes
items.does: Adds a rule that MEMORY.md points to one index file per domain, new leaves go into their domain index, and an index is split once it passes 16 KB.
items.why: A flat index stops scaling past about a hundred leaves and once reached a few bytes under its budget; domain indexes keep the always-loaded part small.
items.notes: Enable later: when the memory index passes about 60 leaves; the budget checker warns before that.

items.title: Memory frontmatter and reachability validator
items.does: Adds tools/memory_validate.py and a rule to run it: every memory leaf has name, description and type, every leaf is reachable from the index, and the index and leaves stay within budget.
items.why: An unindexed leaf is never recalled, and stale leaves kept citing files that no longer existed; a validator finds both before they mislead a session.

items.title: Local memory vault (MCP server) mirror
items.does: Adds a contract file describing how a local vault you install yourself can mirror the markdown memory and inject one bounded recall block per session over MCP.
items.why: Keyword search misses paraphrased past decisions once memory is large; a bounded injected block costs at most a few thousand characters per session. The profile never installs a vault binary.
items.notes: Enable later: once memory passes a few hundred leaves and keyword search starts missing decisions.

items.title: Compact recall wrapper (key + summary, top 8)
items.does: Adds a rule that vault recall returns only category, key and a short summary per hit, eight hits by default, with the body fetched by key.
items.why: Raw recall returned every body, sometimes twice, and flooded the context it was meant to save.
items.notes: Enable later: together with a memory vault, to keep each recall to a few thousand characters.

items.title: Vault sync + coverage gate (embedded == active)
items.does: Adds a rule that the vault mirror is idempotent and that a coverage gate requires every active row to be embedded before the vault counts as healthy.
items.why: An ingest once embedded a small fraction of the rows and still reported healthy; a count check is the only proof that recall can find what memory holds.
items.notes: Enable later: together with a memory vault, before relying on it for recall.

items.title: Project slug resolver (worktrees and moved repos)
items.does: Adds tools/project_slug.py, which prints the Claude project folder for the main checkout from any worktree and lists folders that look like stale copies after a move.
items.why: After a repo moved, readers kept using a dead project folder and memory existed in two diverging copies; resolving the folder from the main checkout avoids both.
items.notes: Enable later: after moving the repo to another drive or folder, or when you work from worktrees.
